svg.title: Emergency coordinator — Man
svg.desc: A fictional man working as emergency coordinator, wearing a safety vest. Visible work cue: A folded incident map stands beside a broadcasting coordination antenna. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Appearance: a ponytail, a tapered face.
